Initial release of "Video Editing with Mac Mini — Edit and Export Mac Videos".

- Upload video clips (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB) and describe edits for fast, AI-assisted processing.
- Automated setup: connects to cloud GPU editing platform and manages tokens/sessions for you.
- Supports quick edits (“trim pauses, add transitions, export 1080p MP4”) with download-ready MP4 output.
- Handles video, audio, and text track edits; guides you based on your instructions.
- No need to install large software—editing and rendering are entirely cloud-based.
- Built-in error handling, automatic re-authentication, and session management for smooth workflow.
